page.overview:
What is Galarian Rapidash?

Rapidash is a cream-colored, equine Pokémon with red eyes and a longhorn atop its head, similar to a unicorn. Its mane and tail are comprised of red and yellow flames, while smaller embers trail from its fetlocks.

Galarian Rapidash is a pure equine Pokémon with a slender, graceful build and a mystical presence. Its body is cream-white, and it has large, ocean-blue eyes. Atop its head is a long, spiraled horn, resembling that of a unicorn, glowing faintly with a magical aura. Its mane and tail are composed of flowing, pastel-colored strands, consisting of light lavender-pink and light blue that drift like enchanted mist. These silky locks ripple gently even without wind, giving it an ethereal, dreamlike appearance. Smaller wisps of its mane trail down its legs, replacing the fiery fetlocks of its Kantonian counterpart with soft, magical tufts. Its hooves are dark magenta.

Rapidash is rather competitive and tends to have a rash nature. The fastest Rapidash will be chosen as its herd's leader, which determines the direction the herd is heading and the speed its herd runs. They are quite rare in the wild and can be found mostly in Kanto, although sightings in Sinnoh, Johto and Unova have occasionally been reported.

Galarian Rapidash is intrepid and resolute, taking pride in its abilities on being able to dash across the forests with the psychic powers stored in the hair around its hooves. Galarian Rapidash are reported to be sighted in woods and forests like Glimwood Tangle in Galar.
